verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a Biometric Liveness solution that confirms the captured biometric data comes from a live person, available via API, web flow and native SDKs. The evidence does not show a selfie being matched to the document portrait, and it names no specific presentation-attack defenses. Missing for 10: documented selfie-to-document-portrait face matching, explicit defenses against printed photos, screen replays and replayed video, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video

citations.quote: Veriff Biometric Liveness solution ensures that the biometric data being captured is from a live person, significantly reducing the risk of fraud.
It is available via API, web flow, and native SDKs.
